description: FINE-TUNING on DIBCO real documents for VISUAL QUALITY ONLY. Loads best checkpoint from thin_stroke_preservation_v1_academic (ckpt-99), disables CTC loss (no text labels in DIBCO), focuses on pixel-level restoration with lower LR. Target: Improve generalization to real historical degradation patterns (bleed-through, fading, stains) not seen in synthetic data.

experiment_metadata.hypothesis: Model trained on synthetic data (thin_stroke_preservation_v1) will improve on REAL historical documents through fine-tuning with lower LR and visual-only objectives.
experiment_metadata.training_strategy: Fine-tuning with VISUAL-ONLY loss (no CTC, no HTR)

rationale.ctc_loss_0: DIBCO has NO text annotations - pure binarization task. CTC loss disabled completely.
rationale.rec_feat_loss_0: No HTR features needed - focus purely on visual restoration quality.
rationale.lr_reduced_40x: LR reduced from 0.0002 to 0.00005 (40x lower) - prevents catastrophic forgetting of synthetic knowledge, allows gentle adaptation to real degradation.
rationale.pixel_200: Maintained from baseline - STRONGEST preservation signal for thin strokes.
rationale.adv_1.5: Maintained from baseline - balanced adversarial for realistic output.
rationale.perceptual_10: Maintained from baseline - VGG features preserve topology and structure.
rationale.no_warmup_annealing: Not needed - starting from well-trained checkpoint, not from scratch.
rationale.early_stopping_psnr_only: Monitor PSNR only (no CER available without labels). Patience=8 for real data variability.
rationale.batch_size_4: Increased from 2 to 4 - DIBCO images are smaller/simpler than synthetic paleographic text.
rationale.epochs_20: Conservative fine-tuning - avoid overfitting to limited DIBCO samples.

dibco_characteristics.degradation_types: Bleed-through, fading, stains, uneven illumination, paper texture
dibco_characteristics.difference_from_synthetic: Real physical degradation vs simulated noise
dibco_characteristics.expected_benefit: Improved generalization to real-world historical documents
dibco_characteristics.test_set: DIBCO 2012 (held out, never seen during training)

risk_mitigation.overfitting: Low LR + early stopping + limited epochs
risk_mitigation.catastrophic_forgetting: Very low LR (0.00005) + keep loss weights from baseline
risk_mitigation.domain_shift: Gradual adaptation through fine-tuning, not retraining from scratch
